anthropic.request_options_note: request_options are added to every Claude request for that model: 'thinking' goes into the body as is, 'effort' into output_config.effort. Haiku 5.5 thinks by default and thinking tokens count toward max_tokens, so it is turned off ({"type": "disabled"}, accepted at effort high or below). Sonnet 5.5 rejects 'disabled'; {"type": "between_tools"} turns thinking off there (effort high or below). Remove 'thinking' to use the model's default. If Claude answers 400 about thinking, the studio retries once without it and notes this in the run log.
